subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should this cumulative opt-in durable-core stack be sponsored for the already-published `release/2026.7.1` line, or retargeted to `main` or a future release after the predecessor stack lands?
rationale: The branch adds stored-state, protocol, plugin SDK, CLI, and startup behavior beyond a narrow repair, and the repository context contains no maintainer confirmation that this new core runtime belongs in the published release line.

options.title: Retarget to a future release
options.body: Land or consolidate the predecessor stack first, then rebase this final slice onto `main` or the next active release with exact-head upgrade and restart proof.

options.title: Sponsor 2026.7.1 inclusion
options.body: Explicitly accept the release-line expansion, require ordered stack landing, and obtain full fresh-install, upgrade, and exact-head session-generation proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the durable-core stack
options.body: Leave the PRs unmerged or close them if maintainers do not want this core runtime direction in the near-term product.

recommendation.title: Retarget to a future release
recommendation.body: Land or consolidate the predecessor stack first, then rebase this final slice onto `main` or the next active release with exact-head upgrade and restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and owned the existing restart-sentinel wake seam that this stack extends, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the release and compatibility choice.
